mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and increasing the probability of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (measured by a 10-year rolling window of 20-day returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% (measured by a 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 growth and INDPRO rise fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances (measured by a 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) above 1300.0 units signal strong consumer demand for housing, supporting construction and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0 (measured by a 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tight labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5% (measured by a 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (measured by a 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2.5% while inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 250.0, it indicates aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 250.0 (measured by a 10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdowns, industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals weakening output, reducing corporate margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0 (measured by a 10-year rolling window).
